notes: Separate final-version media; all previous D/B+C/pilot sources and outputs remain read-only.
prepareReady releases source extraction only. Source anatomy/mechanics and generated temporal frames require visual review before export.
A normal loop has 19 forward PNGs and 17 byte-exact return copies: 36 frames / 3 seconds.
Alternating lunge is a 48-frame full cycle / 4 seconds. Standing keys 0,8,15 reuse exactly the first cell; 15-to-0 is an intentional short hold.
Plank is one stable source image: 36 identical video frames at 12 fps, one GIF frame held for 3000 ms.
No human mesh, generated intermediate art, human warp, fake noise or invented breathing is used by this builder.
Limb landmarks measure projected 2D proportions only. Review camera foreshortening, joint mechanics and rigid equipment separately.
